versions.content: AUTOSAR RTE shall support a bypass selectable after generation of an ECU image Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR RTE shall support bypass selectable after generation of an ECU image. Rationale: This allows establishing a bypass without requiring neither access to the ECU software source nor to the tools to rebuild the ECU software. This supports the requirements of established Tier1/OEM rapid prototyping workflows. In order to support experimental development with the ECU image “selectable” can include both whether or not a signal is bypassed as well as run-time enable/disable of the bypass Use Case: A bypass user extends the functionality of a power-train ECU to perform experimental validation of new algorithms Dependencies: MC Support Data, RTE generator Supporting Material: --
